# passwordsafe_secret_totp_code_ephemeral (Ephemeral Resource)

Secret TOTP Code Ephemeral Resource, gets the current TOTP code of a credential secret. Requires API version 3.3.

## Example Usage

```terraform
ephemeral "passwordsafe_secret_totp_code_ephemeral" "totp" {
  secret_id = passwordsafe_credential_secret.my_totp_credenial_secret.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `secret_id` (String) ID of a credential secret with TOTP enabled

### Read-Only

- `code` (String, Sensitive) Current TOTP code
- `valid_from_utc` (String) Start of the code validity window (inclusive), RFC 3339
- `valid_to_utc` (String) End of the code validity window (exclusive), RFC 3339
